conversation_sequence.user_intent: Investigate whether it would be practical to use a ChatGPT/OpenAI API key from within Mathematica.
conversation_sequence.resulting_design_input: Consider Mathematica as an OpenAI API client rather than depending only on ChatGPT-to-Wolfram integration.

conversation_sequence.design_conclusion: Use Mathematica/Wolfram Language as the authoritative numerical and symbolic layer and an OpenAI model as a scientific reasoning/interpretation layer.
connection_routes: native Wolfram LLM interface where available
direct OpenAI HTTPS/REST fallback from Wolfram Language

conversation_sequence.user_intent: Estimate the cost of the proposed integration.
conversation_sequence.resulting_design_input: Keep large numerical work inside Mathematica, transmit compact summaries, use model routing/caching where applicable, and begin with a $10-$30 development target and a $50 hard development cap.

conversation_sequence.user_intent: Generate a project plan implementing the discussed techniques.
conversation_sequence.resulting_design_input: Produce a phased scientific/engineering plan including connectivity, secure credentials, schemas, bounded tool use, 600-neuron verification, population-to-shape experiments, cost control, provenance, testing, and project-history integration.

conversation_sequence.user_intent: Update the project files with the structured plan and a summary of what generated it.
conversation_sequence.resulting_action: Persist the plan and this provenance summary as additive project documentation and allow the repository's paired-history workflow to capture the change.

existing_project_context_that_shaped_the: The project is treated as a scientific research and engineering project with explicit evidence boundaries.
A Wolfram audit and dependency recheck already exist and must not be silently replaced by assumptions.
The repository already contains a 600-output-neuron backpropagation verification target suitable for the first end-to-end integration experiment.
The project includes population-to-shape and synesthetic visualization work, motivating a later observer/interpretation layer.
The repository uses append-only paired scientific and non-scientific histories and forbids silent overwriting of legacy aggregates.
Prior project policy requires blocked/skipped Wolfram verification to remain clearly distinguished from passed verification.

core_rationale.reasoning_role: OpenAI model interprets structured evidence, identifies anomalies, and proposes bounded follow-up tests.
core_rationale.permanent_rule: No GPT interpretation may replace a calculation that Mathematica can perform directly.
core_rationale.fallback_strategy: Retain direct HTTPS/REST access from Wolfram Language so higher-level Wolfram/OpenAI connector failure is not the only integration path.

optimization_principles: avoid repeatedly transmitting full neuron/weight/timestep state
use lower-cost models for routine analysis and higher-capability reasoning only when justified
measure actual token usage and cost per experiment
cost_assumptions.caveat: API prices, model names, and model availability are time-sensitive and must be reverified before implementation or budgeting.
